answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents anchor identity in cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. New clusters must stake tiered collateral at the summit registry: creating each subsequent node scales deposits by an exponential factor O(2^k). While a small operator can stake a single green node on a modest knoll, scaling a synthetic swarm depletes reserves into exponential capital exhaustion. Every jade credential requires unique cryptographic proofs of compute, ensuring superlinear attacker cost.
